Morning Brief — 2026-08-24

Focus today

  1. Jackson Hole T-3 (Warsh keynote Fri Aug 28) — why now: first Warsh address; digital assets theme = regulatory binary
  2. market-context-refresh: 2 consecutive failures — why now: 13:00 UTC run fires today; pipeline running blind
  3. Stoiiic cooldown warning vs 4-of-5 bullish consensus — why now: leverage-breadth overheat at $78K resistance cluster

Since yesterday

  • [moved] Group BTC: KillaXBT (re-acc cycle), bull_genius ("75.8k dip was it — buy every dip"), WR (4yr cycle + 28B upside liquidation map), trading_axe (bull market prelims) — all confirmed bullish overnight; 4/5 aligned, swarmister still short BTC but added BNB/SHIB alts
  • [moved] Stoiiic overheat signal: leverage-breadth flags median −11.3% drawdown over next 14d (90% CI −14.5 to −3.7%) across 8 historical episodes; alerted
  • [moved] Stoiiic OI extension ranking (corrected): ENA leading (+91% price/+19 OI ext), PEPE 2nd, ZEC/AAVE/HYPE cluster — alt-season structure documented
  • [stuck] WR "four year cycle / best comp" calibration (Aug 23 23:37Z) — sent, no response yet
  • [moved] morning-pipeline chain: token-movers + market-context-refresh both failed 07:39 UTC; brief ran without upstream data

Watch

  • Warsh at Jackson Hole Aug 28: "Financial Innovation / Payments & Policy" theme — CBDCs + stablecoin regulatory direction on the table, not just rate signal; direct re-rating risk or catalyst for HYPE/XRP/BTC

Running today

  • token-alert @ 12:00 UTC
  • token-movers @ 12:00 UTC (1 failure)
  • market-context-refresh @ 13:00 UTC (2 consecutive failures)
  • narrative-tracker @ 13:30 UTC
  • heartbeat @ 20:00 UTC
  • x-trader-monitor / discord-trader-monitor: continuous
